nodes.dialogue_text: My arrows shatter against him like twigs. My Gandiva is useless. Even in wrestling, he throws me easily. Who is this forest hunter?!

choices.choice_text: [Meditate. Offer flowers to the clay lingam of Shiva to gather strength.]

nodes.dialogue_text: Wait—the flowers I just placed on the lingam... they rest upon the crown of the hunter!
The hunter's form dissolved into the terrifying, beautiful visage of Mahadeva.

(Shiva speaks) 'I am pleased with your valor, O Partha. No mortal could withstand my blows as you have. Take this — the Pashupatastra. But beware: it cannot be used against lesser men, for it can destroy the universe.'
